# EverBloom Studio

> Preserved botanicals and handcrafted goods, designed in Brooklyn, New York. The online shop is opening soon. Two PDF pattern lines are in preparation and are not for sale yet.

EverBloom Studio LLC was founded in New York in 2026. The studio makes preserved botanicals, handcrafted leather goods, ceramic mini vases, cross-stitch embroidery, vintage map prints, and custom city map posters. Finished goods come from small workshops and are tested in Brooklyn before they are listed for sale. Preserved botanicals come from a partner workshop in Lingyuan, Liaoning.

Two digital pattern lines are coming later: floral hand-embroidery PDFs (surface embroidery, not cross-stitch) and sewing patterns for doll clothes drafted to fit 18-inch dolls. There is no checkout, no pattern file to download, and no reviews or sales figures. To be notified, email info@everbloomstudio.us.

Wholesale inquiries are open for the preserved botanical line. Leather, ceramic, and cross-stitch lines open to retail partners as testing completes. The PDF patterns are planned as direct studio downloads, not wholesale.

- Website: https://everbloomstudio.us/
- Email: info@everbloomstudio.us
- Location: Brooklyn, New York

## Floral hand embroidery PDF patterns

Coming soon. Launch pricing is planned from $5.99 per pattern, within a band of about $5.99 to $7.99, with a three-pattern bundle from $16.99. Each PDF is planned to include a printable line-art template for 4-inch, 6-inch, and 8-inch hoops, a stitch guide with step diagrams (stem stitch, satin stitch, French knots, and related stitches), a DMC cotton-floss color list, a supply list, and a photograph of the finished piece once a sample has been stitched. These are hand-embroidery patterns, not cross-stitch and not a finished stitched hoop.

## Doll clothes sewing patterns

Coming soon. Patterns are being drafted to fit 18-inch dolls (about 18 in tall, chest about 11 1/4 in, waist about 10 1/2 in, hips about 12 in). Launch pricing is planned around $6.99 for a single pattern and $16.99 for a four-piece wardrobe set: a day dress, a blouse, a pinafore, and bloomers, in floral and botanical cloth. Describe the fit only as 18-inch dolls. The patterns are not affiliated with, licensed by, or endorsed by any doll manufacturer, and the site does not use doll brand names.
